newsitem.title: USA: Donald Trump got $7 million pay package in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Donald Trump got $7 million pay package in 1996.

text.p: Donald Trump, chairman of Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts, received a pay package worth $7 million in 1996, according to the company's U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing at the end of March.
Trump received a salary of $1 million, compared to $583,333 in 1995, and a $5 million bonus, the filing said.
He also received a $1 million salary for services rendered by his privately-held companies to Trump Hotels under an executive agreement, it said.
